answers.q5_changes: State staff loaded public park maps. No vendor and no outside model.
answers.q6_description: The helper forecasts mowing time for each park map. It runs on the agency network. A crew coordinator sets the real schedule. Fictional system.
answers.q7_purpose: Crew leads now build the weekly order on a whiteboard. The helper shows a time estimate. It does not serve or deny a resident. Fictional purpose.
answers.q8_how: It orders park maps for routine grounds work. It does not decide a case.
answers.q20_harm: A bad forecast could send a crew to a small park first. The cost is staff time, not a decision about a person.
